content:
[DOMAIN: Communication] [CATEGORY: ASD_Intervention] [SUBCATEGORY: PECS_Phase_1] [TARGET: Early_Childhood]
Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS) Phase I: Physical Exchange. Upon presentation of a preferred reinforcing item, the learner will reach for a picture symbol of that item, pick up the symbol, and release it into the open hand of a communicative partner across 4 out of 5 consecutive trials with physical prompting faded to independent exchange.

rgori_mapping.functionality_indicator: Functional requesting to fulfill basic wants
rgori_mapping.generality_indicator: Across 2 communicative partners and 3 preferred items

content:

Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS) Phase II: Distance and Persistence. The learner navigates to a communication book located at least 3 meters away, retrieves a single picture icon, and travels to hand it to a communicative partner across 80% of observed opportunities across 4 consecutive classroom sessions.

rgori_mapping.measurable_criterion: 80% of observed opportunities across 4 consecutive classroom sessions
rgori_mapping.generality_indicator: Across classroom and learning center workstations

content:
[DOMAIN: Communication] [CATEGORY: ASD_Intervention] [SUBCATEGORY: PECS_Phase_3] [TARGET: Elementary_Primary]
Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS) Phase III: Visual Discrimination. When presented with a communication board displaying an array of 4 distinct icons (2 preferred items and 2 non-preferred distractors), the learner will discriminate and select the target item icon and hand it to the partner with 85% accuracy across 5 consecutive sessions.

rgori_mapping.functionality_indicator: Accurate discrimination between desired and neutral items
rgori_mapping.generality_indicator: Using varied array configurations and teacher/aide partners
rgori_mapping.context_indicator: Classroom instruction and leisure choice periods

content:
[DOMAIN: Communication] [CATEGORY: ASD_Intervention] [SUBCATEGORY: PECS_Phase_4] [TARGET: Elementary_Primary]
Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS) Phase IV: Sentence Structure. The student requests desired items using a multi-word phrase by constructing a sentence strip featuring an 'I want' icon followed by an item picture icon, detaching the strip, and handing it to the communicative partner with 80% independent accuracy across 4 consecutive classroom sessions.

rgori_mapping.measurable_criterion: 80% independent accuracy across 4 consecutive classroom sessions
rgori_mapping.functionality_indicator: Independent expression of structured wants and needs
